sources.entry: 🧰 kahun/awesome-sysadmin: a curated list of amazingly awesome open source sysadmin resources

summary.one_liner: A curated, categorized list of open source sysadmin tools and resources spanning backups, monitoring, configuration management, DNS, mail, VPNs, and more.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome" list: a Markdown document of links to sysadmin software, organized into topical sections such as Backups, Monitoring, Configuration Management, DNS, Mail Servers, VPN, Web servers, and Virtualization. Each entry is a project name followed by a one-line description, and some sections have sub-groups (for example, Monitoring is split into software, dashboards, and distributions). A second part, Resources, lists blogs, books, newsletters, package repositories, and websites for sysadmins. The README itself contains no code, install steps, or runnable software. Some entries are marked as no longer maintained, and a few appear in more than one section.
use_cases: finding an open source backup tool
choosing a monitoring or alerting system
picking a DNS server or VPN software
locating self-hosted mail, wiki, or ticketing software
notable: Covers a broad range of sysadmin categories in one place, from backups and DNS to ChatOps and wikis
Each entry has a short description, so it works as a quick comparison index
Includes a Resources section with books, blogs, newsletters, and package repositories
Flags some projects as no longer maintained (for example, dashing)
caveats: Link-only list: it does not run or install anything, and descriptions are brief
Some entries are outdated or duplicated across sections, and some are marked no longer maintained
Content is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0, which the README states
